info.title: Photographic Styles Shortcuts API
info.description: Design contract only; backend not implemented. Styles and Texture always enabled; optional AI Portrait.

post.summary: Return a still HEIC with Styles and Texture

parameters.name: portrait
parameters.description: Generate editable Portrait only when requested and no original depth exists.

parameters.name: focusX
parameters.description: Normalized display coordinate for new Portrait.

parameters.name: focusY
parameters.description: Normalized display coordinate for new Portrait.

requestBody.description: Original file, maximum 20 MiB; format checked from bytes, not just MIME. Live Photo HEIC is processed as a still.

200.description: Complete HEIC. Portrait starts off; enable in Photos. Existing native depth and Styles take precedence.

Error.description: Processing failed; no silently degraded photo. Codes distinguish invalid input, authentication, limits, unsupported format, incompatible graph, HDR transfer, Portrait inference, rate limiting, unavailable runtime and timeout.
